newsitem.title: GERMANY: Price for new Fresenius shares to be set.
newsitem.headline: Price for new Fresenius shares to be set.

text.p: Germany's Fresenius Medical Care AG said on Thursday that the price for its upcoming offering of preference shares would be set on November 23 and then announced a day later to the public.
The new shares are scheduled to begin trade on November 25, the company said in a newspaper advertisement to fulfil German securities regulations.
The group, a unit of Fresenius AG, is planning to issue five million new non-voting preference shares worth a nominal 25 million marks.
Fresenius Medical was formed in a series of transactions culminating in the combination of the global dialysis business of Fresenius AG and the global dialysis business of U.S.-based W.R. Grace.
The bookbuilding period for the offering runs from November 11-22 and the new shares will be traded on bourses in Frankfurt and New York.
